title: AI Test Data and Synthetic Data Governance

questions.question: Why does synthetic test data still need governance?
options: It can leak patterns, miss coverage, drift, or create false confidence
questions.explanation: Synthetic data can still carry privacy and quality risks.

questions.question: Which signal is part of this lesson?
questions.explanation: Data leakage must be tested before synthetic data is used.

questions.question: What does the Python artifact produce?
options: A ranked test-data governance plan with controls
questions.explanation: The artifact recommends governance controls for test-data scenarios.

questions.question: Which control belongs to this lesson?
questions.explanation: Coverage matrices make test-data adequacy visible.

questions.question: When should synthetic data require governance review?
options: When privacy risk, leakage risk, coverage gaps, or synthetic drift are present
Only when data is public and irrelevant
Only when no tests use it
questions.explanation: These signals indicate higher governance need.

questions.question: What should be checked before synthetic data is used in tests?
questions.explanation: These checks keep synthetic test data useful and safe.
